requirement.statement: Eidolon AI workflow tools SHALL delegate workflow inspection, validation and authoring commands to a shared workflow component/service instead of implementing independent tool-local workflow logic.

case.given: WorkflowInspectCapability and WorkflowValidateResourceRef are registered as Eidolon native tools
case.then: they SHALL use the shared workflow component/service command or query boundary

requirement.statement: Eidolon SHALL expose controlled workflow authoring tools that create or patch XNL workflow bundles through the workflow component write boundary.

case.given: a workflow create request contains bundle resource references
case.when: the workflow component prepares the bundle draft
case.then: the component SHALL validate resource refs and reject host absolute paths, traversal, naked relative paths, file refs and http refs

case.given: an AI agent asks to create or patch a workflow
case.then: the tool SHALL return structured JSON evidence describing files, refs and validation diagnostics

requirement.statement: Eidolon AI workflow integration SHALL NOT add an MCP adapter or MCP tool surface in this track.

case.given: workflow native component and tools are added to Eidolon
case.then: the added surface SHALL be Eidolon native tools only; MCP remains out of scope
